newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina promotes mortgage bank sale in US, Europe.
newsitem.headline: Argentina promotes mortgage bank sale in US, Europe.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez was due in New York Monday to kick off a U.S. and European tour to promote the privatization of state mortgage lender Banco Hipotecario Nacional.

An Economy Ministry spokeswoman said Fernandez departed Buenos Aires Sunday night accompanied by Treasury Secretary Pablo Guidotti and would visit New York, Washington, London and Paris to meet government officials and business leaders.
But she would not comment on media reports that Fernandez would also be seeking $2.0 billion in bridging loan facilities on the strength of the Banco Hipotecario sale.

Fernandez was due to visit the Wall Street Journal in New York on Monday then fly to Washington Tuesday to meet U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers and Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.

In London on Thursday, the Argentine minister is due to meet Bank of England Governor Eddie George and the Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown. In Paris on Friday he will meet Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Khan and Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet.

The Banco Hipotecario privatization, which was given final approval by the Argentine Congress earlier this month, is expected to raise about $3.0 billion that has been earmarked for housing and infrastructure projects.

A quick start for such projects is vital for President Carlos Menem's Peronist government, which needs good news on job-creation to counter high unemployment ahead of key elections in Congress in October.
